title: Atlas dated observation and knowledge-revision integration proof
uncertainty: Can retained genuinely dated observations coexist with administrative corrections and later knowledge revisions in one coherent qualified world, with physical support/time distinguished from recording/publication time, honest observation gaps, scoped freshness and immutable historical answers?
why: Real regional derivations now compose correctly with scoped dependencies. Their unknown cell epochs and administrative updates do not test observation-time revision semantics. Retained Exe JRC GSW March/September 2024 and historical event/inventory evidence provide a concrete existing dated population without acquisition.
prerequisites: unchanged accepted Tryfan/Riffelhorn and completed multi-region/dependency proofs
inspect exact retained Exe source identities, rights, spatial support and month/event qualifications before selecting the bounded dated subset
accepted full-validation and composite publication/pinning boundaries
evidence: docs/research/atlas-derived-understanding-lifecycle.md sections C and physical/knowledge revision semantics
permittedWork: freeze a small accountable retained dated observation subset; use already retained data only
register native dated observations, explicit no-observation/non-detection states and exact support in isolated proof state
exercise separately labelled administrative corrections/withdrawals or applicability revisions without claiming newly acquired physical observations
compare fixed-period and as-known-at answers, scoped freshness and coherent pinned/history replay
reuse established methods and publication boundaries; no tidal/seasonal inference, new algorithms, acquisition or infrastructure
deliverable: Bounded dated-observation and knowledge-revision integration proof with identities, physical versus knowledge time, correct qualified historical/current answers, failures, measurements and one next task.
acceptanceCriteria: selected dated records and product versions are attributable to retained artifacts
observation month/event time remains distinct from product/processing/publication time
unobserved and non-detected remain distinct and neither is unqualified physical absence
corrections to a past slice and additions of another dated slice have explicit different revision semantics
fixed-period/current-policy invalidation and unaffected reuse match independent expected closures
qualified exact result and provenance identities agree with native/reference queries
old pins and fresh historical replay remain coherent; incomplete/invalid updates stay unpublished
stopCondition: Stop after judging the bounded dated/correction integration, measuring costs, documenting limitations and selecting one next task. Do not infer physical change from date differences or begin runtime/storage/service/Weather work. If retained dated provenance or rights are insufficient, identify the precise prerequisite rather than inventing dates or acquiring evidence.
